scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix contracts && npm ci --prefix site
scripts.build: node scripts/check-build-env.mjs && npm run build:assets && npm --prefix site run build
scripts.abi: npm --prefix contracts run abi && node scripts/sync-abi.mjs
scripts.test:contracts: npm --prefix contracts test && npm run abi:check
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:assets && npm --prefix site run test:e2e
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:e2e
